prompt: Some people believe that private cars should be banned from the centres of large cities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
In the big cities of the world, the traffic is a very serious problem. Every morning the people spend a long time in the traffic jam and the air is very polluted. For this reason, some people say that the private cars must be banned in the centre of the city. I agree with this opinion, because the benefits are more than the disadvantages.

Firstly, the air quality will improve a lot. The cars produce a lot of the pollution which cause the asthma and the other diseases, especially for the children and the old people. If we remove the cars from the centre, the people can breathe the clean air, and also the noise will be less. This is very good for the health.

Secondly, the centre will become more beautiful and more safe. Now the streets are full of the cars and there is no space for the people. If the cars are banned, the government can build more parks, more bicycle lanes and more cafes in the street. The tourists will come more and the shops will earn more money. In many European cities they did this and it was successful.

On the other hand, some people will have the difficulty, for example the old people, the disabled people and the shopkeepers who need to bring their products. But I think the government can give them the special permission.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that the private cars should not enter in the city centre, because the city will be cleaner, safer and more beautiful for everybody, but the government must first improve the public transport.
title: Banning cars from city centres
